items.new_text: `Transferir atendimento do Ticket #N` (`transfer-modal-content.html`) offers Queue and Agent radio choices, a selector, and `Cancelar` / `Transferir ticket`. As in the reference and `packages/core/src/conversa/maquina.ts`, transfer closes this ticket and opens another.
Remove a tag from the open conversation through `DELETE /v1/conversas/:id/etiquetas/:etiquetaId`. This does not close the ticket: source `ADD_TAGS` is separate from `CLOSE_TICKET`.
`Finalizar atendimento do Ticket #N` (`close-modal-container.js`) includes confirmation text, `Adicionar tags`, and `Cancelar` / `Finalizar ticket`. The `api` requires a tag for `POST /encerrar`.

`Exportar ticket` needs no new backend: all thread `itens` are already loaded, so build a `.txt` transcript and download it in the browser. This is the simple version of reference transcript download (`blip-desk-funcoes.md` §7), without asynchronous email for a 90-day-to-5-year manager report outside this agent screen.

Attendance screen at `/` and `/chat/:id` follows three reference columns: `.sidenav` (25%), `.pane-chat` (50%), `.drawer` (25%). Poll `GET /v1/desk/fila` and `GET /v1/desk/conversas/:id` every 15s, matching source `POLLING_INTERVAL` in settings.json. Advance `agora` every second for relative times and timers. Center states follow source `pane-chat`: `Buscando tickets` before queue load; `Fique online para atender` with a reason when invisible/paused without tickets; `Tudo pronto para atender` without selection; then the conversation.
If this conversation does not belong to the agent or does not exist, return to the list as in the reference.

Reference contact `.drawer` (`~/desk-clone/capturas/parciais/drawer.html`) has `Dados do Contato` and `Informações`, `Histórico`, `Comentários` tabs with `bds-paper` stacks. Source `Falar com gestor` is manager chat, absent in Pipe. Information includes name, ID, email, phone, document, raw key/value extras, and copy buttons. `Comentários` shows an empty state or entry field; these are internal conversation notes (`itens` of kind `nota`) saved through `salvarNotaInterna`.

Contact-panel `Editar` calls `PATCH /v1/contatos/:id` (`controladores/catalogo.ts`), already tested and guarded by `contato.editar`. Send only changed fields; an empty field sends an empty string, which the API stores as given. The API distinguishes clearing a field from leaving it untouched.

Contact tags live in `contato_etiqueta`, previously without a route or screen. Fetch the catalog from `GET /v1/etiquetas?escopo=contato` (scopes `contato` and `ambos`); apply/remove via `POST`/`DELETE /v1/contatos/:id/etiquetas` under contact-edit permission `contato.editar`. A contact tag is contact data.
Leave edit mode when switching tickets, so one contact's form cannot remain open over another contact's data.

items.new_text: Start at the bottom (`startBottom`) and scroll back to the bottom after each new message.

Reference thread `message-list--panechat` (`~/desk-clone/capturas/parciais/thread.html`) groups `.blip-card` bubbles in `.card-group-container` with `.blip-message-group > .blip-card-group.left|right`, with `.group-notification` time on the speaker's side and delivery signal before time for outgoing groups. Put ticket-opening `.ticket .fancy` and `h3` before messages. Show the return-to-bottom button beyond 150px from the bottom (source settings.json `MINIMUM_SCROLL_DISTANCE`).

Contacts tab follows reference MFE `desk-contact-history`, measured on the mock in `~/desk-clone/clone/mfe-teste.html` (`desk2/blip-contacts-1200.png`, `blip-contatos-aberto.png`): 300/600/300 columns. Left has 110px heading/search/sort and grouped 62px contact cards. Center shows an empty prompt, then new-conversation card, or ticket transcript. Right has `Histórico` and `Contato` tabs. Read only through `GET /v1/desk/contatos?busca=`, `/contatos/:id`, and `/tickets/:id`, as in the reference.
Use `dd/mm/aaaa, HH:mm` for MFE `Última interação`.

Invitation screen is public like sign-in: requiring a session for `GET /v1/convites/:token` would create a cycle for the account this invitation creates. Show only the API's minimal invite details: recipient, role, company, expiry. Possession of the link already reveals the email, not other account data. Continue through `/v1/auth/google?convite=<token>` for users without a verified domain; the invitation, not the domain, selects the tenant.
Expired, used, and nonexistent invitations share the same screen so the link holder cannot learn whether a token ever existed.
Sign-in uses its own font; it is the only product screen outside the app's typography.
Google sign-in is a link because it navigates to the `api` at the top level.
The pictured password field has no `name`: Pipe does not yet support password sign-in, and typed passwords never leave this page. Ponytail: add `name` only when the API accepts passwords.
Inline official Google `G` so sign-in does not depend on a third-party image request.

Desk sign-in copies `apps/gestao-vite/src/paginas/entrar.tsx`, changing only the title to `Entrar no Pipe Desk`. Discovery runs in the browser: Vite proxies in development and this app's origin belongs in `PIPE_ORIGENS` in production. No tenant is known or disclosed before login. Each of the seven `RECUSAS_DE_ENTRADA` codes in `?erro=` gives a specific exit rather than a generic unauthorized message.
Without SSO, keep the person on this screen with the reason and the email already entered.
That extra pixel would provide no visible benefit.

items.new_text: Arc center as a fraction of the box; radius as a fraction of the diagonal.
Three layers from edge inward; `op` is the opacity range.

Sign-in background draws about 10,800 particles in browser `<canvas>`, avoiding a GIF, video, or image download (the reference background was 14.6 MB). The enlarged brand curve forms one arc centered outside the lower-right frame, in three layers: sharp edge, diffuse body, mist. Leave upper-left space clear for the form. Continuous particle positions avoid a repeated animation seam. With `prefers-reduced-motion`, draw one frame and stop; no separate still image is downloaded.
Use a fixed particle-generator seed so every machine and reload shows the same design. A changing background adds noise and prevents comparing screenshots.
`1 - rnd^0.7` concentrates particles near the edge, creating the sharp line.
Each particle has its own speed; outer particles move more slowly, so the beam shears rather than rotating as one block.
Add a diffuse bright mass in the corner so the card does not float over flat cream.

`Enviar mensagem ativa` at `/activeMessage/send` follows the reference three-step flow (`~/desk-clone/clone/index.html`, active-msg section; `desk2/blip-clone-active.png`): select contact, choose template, review content; show privacy notice, contact form and selected-contacts panel (0/15), then `Cancelar` / `Continuar`. Copy comes from MFE `desk-active-message` (`referencias-blip/pesquisa/blip-desk-vocabulario.md`). Send channel, template, and contacts to existing `api` endpoint `POST /v1/mensagens-ativas`; reference `chatbot` corresponds to our channel.
When arriving from `Conversar novamente` in Contacts, preselect that contact.
Reference `/not-found` is brief: the route does not exist.

`Preferências` at `/preferences` has no measurable rendered reference because `~/desk-clone` leaves MFE `desk-preferences-mfe` blank. Structure follows reference `app.js` i18n (`"preferences":"Preferências","notifications":"Notificações"`) and `referencias-blip/pesquisa/blip-desk-preferencias.md`: immediate switches in sections, no Save button. Ponytail: confirm measurements when the reference screen is extracted. Copy replaces `Blip Desk` with `Pipe Desk`. The five preferences use separate browser keys and belong to this machine, not the person (`referencias-blip/pesquisa/blip-desk-medidas.md` §12).
If storage is unavailable (for example, a private window), this preference applies only in the current tab.
On the VPS Desk lives under `/desk` to share the Gest?o session.

items.new_text: Pipe Desk is a SPA configured like `apps/gestao-vite/vite.config.ts`: Vite/SWC builds a static front end and NestJS `api` remains the only database gateway. In development `/v1` proxies to `api` on 3010 so HttpOnly `pipe_sessao` travels on the same origin without CORS or browser tokens. Desk uses port 3210 and Gestão 3110. Consume `@pipe/ui` as source without a separate build step.
